svg.title: Cloud Native SIEM architecture
svg.desc: A local analyst console uses VirusTotal, saves events and alerts, and publishes to Pub/Sub. A separate local Python worker pulls events and inserts them into BigQuery for SQL investigation.
svg.text: Submit an indicator. Enrich the findings. Investigate the event.
Solid arrows: event / report flow Dashed arrow: acknowledgement after insert; failures trigger redelivery.
